title: Feature Concerns - Resolved Routing Plan
description: Per-feature scope and routing plan produced once at post-spec by the concern-selector agent, within the bounds of the project profile. Lives at specs/NNN-feature/feature-concerns.yaml. The dispatcher dispatches from routing; the consultation audit (stage 2b) checks emitted evidence against it.

profile.description: The profile in effect (the limiter), copied from project-manifest.yaml manifest.substrate.profile.

generated_by.description: Agent that produced this plan, normally concern-selector.

status.description: proposed until the operator approves; the dispatcher dispatches only from an approved plan.

scope.description: Which concern catalogs apply to this feature, and why.

selected.description: Catalogs in scope for this feature.

excluded.description: Catalogs deliberately out of scope, each with a reason (the recorded tailoring).

locked.description: Overlay-mandated catalogs that cannot be excluded regardless of feature, e.g. privacy under a regulated profile.

routing.description: Per-checkpoint resolved dispatch. Keys are checkpoint ids: C1, C2, C3.

reason.description: Why it is in or out of scope (cites stack facts or spec content).

catalogs.description: Concern/threat catalogs this agent consults for this feature (subset of scope.selected). Empty list means the agent is not dispatched at this checkpoint.

layers.description: Depth: layers in scope, bounded by the profile ceiling. Optional in stage 2a (full depth assumed); set by stage 2b.

severities.description: Depth: severities in scope, bounded by the profile ceiling. Optional in stage 2a; set by stage 2b.
